user.description: Set up Custom Metrics Recorder. You can define your record types (e.g. Blood Pressure, Fuel Cost) afterwards via the integration's Configure/Options menu.
user.title: Custom Metrics Recorder

abort.already_configured: Custom Metrics Recorder is already configured (only one instance is supported).

menu_options.edit_record_type: Add fields to an existing record type

edit_record_type.title: Choose a record type to add fields to

add_field.title: Add a field
add_field.description: Fields added so far: {count}. Field keys are stored verbatim in every record - prefer a short key (e.g. "sys" instead of "systolic_pressure") for record types you plan to log frequently via automations.

remove_record_type.title: Remove a record type
remove_record_type.description: This removes the record type definition. Stored records are not deleted from disk until the integration itself is removed.

set_retention_values.title: Retention for {name}
set_retention_values.description: Records are kept forever by default. Optionally set a retention period, a maximum record count, or the threshold at which a warning is raised.

error.already_exists: A record type with this name already exists.
error.reserved_key: This field key is reserved (id, timestamp, record_type) and cannot be used.
error.duplicate_key: This field key is already used by this record type.
error.options_required: Provide at least one option for select fields.

record_count_high.title: Record count is high for {name}
record_count_high.description: The record type "{name}" has {count} stored records. Consider configuring a retention period or a maximum record count for this record type via the integration's Configure/Options menu.
